title: Third-Party Integration API
objective: Consume an external provider and expose a stable internal API.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Provider adapter and credential configuration
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate provider adapter and credential configuration in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Timeouts, bounded retry policy, and backoff
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate timeouts, bounded retry policy, and backoff in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Normalize provider errors and apply appropriate caching
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate normalize provider errors and apply appropriate caching in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Integration tests, quota handling, and failure simulation
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate integration tests, quota handling, and failure simulation in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Timeouts, bounded retry policy, and backoff
Normalize provider errors and apply appropriate caching
Integration tests, quota handling, and failure simulation
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
